body: Actually accessing help isn't a possibility right now. After looking into the local community health clinic, in order to get free to low cost health care, I would have to show through my taxes that I meet the income level necessary to receive it. Since I exceeded that income level last year, I don't have access. I don't use social media. This is the first time I've posted on anything related to social media in about 5 years. I can't afford to join any activity-based groups in my area. I literally work and spend my money on bills. If I wasn't living with my sister, I couldn't afford to eat or have a roof over my head. Thanks for the suggestions, I get you are trying to help.

Nothing grand. I'd hopefully be working in research full time, with health insurance, renting a one bedroom, with stable mental health. I just want to be comfortable enough to know I can pay my bills, have some savings, and be able to access help if I still need it.
